# 石溪心月禪師雜錄

**ID:** X1406
**Volume:** X71
**Category:** 禪宗部類
**Original Category:** 諸宗著述部／禪宗語錄別集
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X1406

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

One-juan miscellany of **Shíxī Xīnyuè** [心月](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BF%83%E6%9C%88) 石溪心月 (d. 1254), *hào* Chuányī 傳衣 ("Robe-Transmitter"), posthumously **Fóhǎi chánshī**. *Xuzangjing* X71 n1406. The running banner reads *Chuányī Shíxī Fóhǎi chánshī zálù*. Occasional verse and prose not absorbed into the main *yǔlù* ([KR6q0338](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0338)): *hé* 和 (response-verse) to laymen, farewell poems for travelling monks, single-*shǒu* occasional pieces. Short but characterful — shares the hermit-poetic sensibility that is a signature of mid-Sòng Jìngshān Chán.
